description.content: This endpoint is used for creating a Pay Request. Your server should create a Pay Request as soon as the total payment amount is known. Once the Pay Request is created, given the terminal is not busy, or offline, the process to pay will be initialised.

response.name: Created
When the provided payload is not valid.
When you don't have the right permissions to create a Pay Request for the provided mid.
When the provided mid is not found.
When the terminal is not paired.

description.content: This endpoint is for fetching Pay Requests.

response.name: The Pay Request response
When the provided `payRequestId` does not match a Pay Request stored in the system.

description.content: An async endpoint used for attempting to answer a pending decision prompt on a terminal. The decisionId & answer is returned by the payRequest in the pendingDecision object, and is required to differentiate prompt messages. There is no result to acknowledge that this decision was received by the terminal.

response.name: Accepted
When the provided payload is not valid.
When you don't have the right permissions to answer a pending decision for the provided payRequest.
When the terminal is not paired.

description.content: An async endpoint used for attempting to cancel a pending decision prompt on a terminal. There is no result to acknowledge that this cancellation was processed by the terminal. If the transaction is already in a fully processed state, this call will be rejected.

response.name: Accepted
When you don't have the right permissions to cancel a pending payRequest.
When the terminal is not paired.

description.content: This endpoint is used for retrieving a merchant.

response.name: The details of the fetched Merchant
